title: You had ALL year to grow your glutes... so what happened? 👀
hook: You had ALL year to grow your glutes... so what happened? 👀
caption:
You had ALL year to grow your glutes... so what happened? 👀

If your booty looks the same in October as it did in January, it's not your genetics. It's usually one (or all) of these:
1️⃣ You didn't train heavy or often enough: glute growth needs progressive overload, close to failure, 2–3 focused glute workouts a week
2️⃣ You skipped your warm-up and mobility: tight hips mean your quads and lower back steal the work
3️⃣ You didn't recover or fuel enough: muscle is built AFTER the workout, with enough protein, enough calories and real rest
